summary: StubHub Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 7 to its February 2020 credit agreement, executed October 14, 2026, with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent. The company upsized its USD Term Loan B from roughly $804 million to $975 million and cut its Euro Term Loan B from about €452 million to €300 million, extending both maturities from March 15, 2030 to October 14, 2033. A $565 million revolver is split between 2030 and 2031 maturities, with SOFR/EURIBOR margins of 4.50%/4.75% and leverage-based step-downs. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
